properties.name: cholewa.validation.english-messages
properties.description: Whether Bean Validation messages are always worded in English, regardless of the locale of the JVM or of the request. Set to false to get them localized.

properties.name: cholewa.rabbit.pod-connection-name
properties.description: Whether a RabbitMQ connection is named after the pod: the value of HOSTNAME when it starts with spring.application.name followed by a dash, otherwise the application name with the suffix -local. Set to false to keep the default name of Spring AMQP.
